entities.summary: Leopold Sonnemann was a German journalist, newspaper publisher, and political party leader during the periods of the North German Confederation and the German Empire. Publisher and editor of the Frankfurter Zeitung, Sonnemann also served as a deputy to the Reichstag and was a founding member of the German People's Party.
